paths.description: Homepage and breaking-news landing template; primary task is scanning current headlines and opening coverage.
Monde section/listing template, representing topic and section indexes.
Current NewsArticle template selected from the published sitemap.
Site-search journey from labelled search form to populated results for “Iran”.
Invalid URL recovery journey, representing HTTP/network failure handling.

findings.summary: The site ignores the user’s dark colour-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: Under emulated prefers-color-scheme: dark, the body remains rgb(255,255,255), computed color-scheme is normal, the screenshot is unchanged, and CSS inspection finds no colour-scheme implementation.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide dark surface/text tokens with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark(), preserving contrast.

findings.summary: Route changes do not use View Transitions.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection across the rendered homepage found no view-transition rules or names; navigation remains a full-document abrupt swap.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance same-origin navigation with cross-document View Transitions and a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.summary: The page chrome does not communicate scroll state.
findings.evidence: The 31,227px-tall mobile homepage has static chrome; CSS inspection found no scroll timeline or scroll-state implementation and no reading/progress cue.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight declarative scroll-state treatment or progress cue where it improves orientation.

findings.summary: A notification activation prompt intrudes on search and error journeys.
findings.evidence: Mobile screenshots show “Activez les notifications” fixed over the bottom of search and 404 content before a user asks for notifications.
findings.suggestedFix: Request notification permission only after an explicit, contextual action and keep the initial task unobscured.

findings.summary: Overlays are implemented as custom dialog-like structures rather than native primitives.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS probe found 11 elements with role=dialog or aria-modal, but zero dialog, popover, or details elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Use dialog for modal flows and popover for transient UI, with native focus handling and light dismiss.

findings.summary: The section template overflows horizontally on a 360px viewport.
findings.evidence: The layout primitive measured scrollWidth 403px against clientWidth 360px on /monde/, a 43px overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the fixed/min-content constraint causing the overflow and use intrinsic/fluid sizing for the topic strip.

findings.summary: Some keyboard-focusable controls have no visible focus indicator.
findings.evidence: The focus probe found visible elements whose computed outline is none and box-shadow none, including menu/list anchors and buttons; axe also reports structural accessibility failures.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply a clear :focus-visible indicator with sufficient contrast to every interactive element and verify a full keyboard walk.

findings.summary: Mobile Largest Contentful Paint misses the good Core Web Vitals range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP at 4.0s (score 0.50) and FCP at 2.3s; the first-party trace was faster but still confirms load work before content settles.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the LCP element, prioritize its request, reduce critical chains, and defer nonessential third-party scripts.

findings.summary: A long main-thread task blocks responsiveness during load.
findings.evidence: The DevTools trace recorded a 465.22ms task and 421.71ms total blocking time across two long tasks.
findings.suggestedFix: Attribute the long task, split work into smaller prioritized tasks, and defer analytics/secondary hydration.

findings.summary: The critical delivery path is fragmented across many CSS and script requests.
findings.evidence: HAR captured 138 requests: 37 stylesheets and 61 scripts. Scripts transferred 853,978 bytes and the summary identifies many parser-inserted stylesheet candidates.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate critical CSS, defer noncritical styles/scripts, and validate each reported render-blocking candidate against DOM placement.

findings.summary: The homepage ships avoidable unused CSS and JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 55KiB unused JavaScript and 16KiB unused CSS on the mobile load.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split by template and defer conditional dependencies until the associated feature is used.

findings.summary: Invalid ARIA and broken list semantics weaken assistive-technology output.
findings.evidence: axe found critical aria-allowed-attr and aria-valid-attr-value violations, 10 malformed lists, 40 orphan list items, a duplicate landmark name, and content outside landmarks; Lighthouse accessibility score is 0.80.
findings.suggestedFix: Correct ARIA values/role support, restore ul/ol and li relationships, and give repeated landmarks unique labels.

findings.summary: Image delivery and semantics are inconsistent.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found 7 images without dimensions, 72 below-fold images without lazy loading, 61 without srcset, 16 legacy-format images, and 25 missing alt attributes.
findings.suggestedFix: Give content images dimensions and meaningful alt, lazy-load below-fold media, and serve responsive modern formats through srcset/picture.

findings.summary: The public news corpus explicitly blocks major AI agents and offers no structured agent capability.
findings.evidence: robots.txt disallows GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-Web, PerplexityBot and other AI agents, while Lighthouse agentic-browsing score is 0.33; server-rendered content itself has 100% crawler coverage.
findings.suggestedFix: Decide and publish an explicit agent-access policy; where desired, expose safe structured read/search capabilities rather than requiring scraping.

findings.summary: Browser security policies and cookie flags are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers probe found no CSP, frame protection, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy. Cookie audit found 14 cookies classed insecure, including non-Secure and SameSite=None values; HSTS and nosniff are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP including frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy; mark HTTPS cookies Secure and choose intentional SameSite lifetimes.

findings.evidence: HAR attributes 759,325 of 1,235,913 transferred bytes (61%) to third parties; tracker capture found 19 third-party origins and known Facebook, Google, Outbrain and other trackers.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply data minimisation, remove low-value trackers, load remaining analytics only after consent/need, and batch events.

findings.summary: The notification nudge is shown without task context.
findings.evidence: Search-result DOM starts with a notification activation panel and screenshots show it over unrelated tasks; the user did not initiate a notification flow.
findings.suggestedFix: Move notification enablement behind a clear user action after explaining the benefit and preserve an easy decline path.

findings.summary: The initial page memory/DOM footprint is large for a news landing page.
findings.evidence: Baseline heap summary contains 547,086 nodes, 2,227,476 edges, and 32,032,181 self-size bytes. Repeated full-page scroll grew self-size only 0.54%, so this is footprint rather than demonstrated leakage.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce hydrated DOM and third-party object populations; virtualize or defer deep below-fold sections and re-profile.
